name: Shamiri Institute: group interventions for adolescent mental health in Kenya (HLI)
summary: Runs group sessions to improve adolescents' mental health in Kenya. A re-implementation of the Happier Lives Institute's spreadsheet, traced cell by cell from its bottom line (WELLBYs per $1,000). Calculated rows reproduce the sheet's values.

sections.title: Discounting
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not HLI's. HLI counts a year of benefit the same whenever it comes. In our view, later years count less at the discount rate under Your values, as in GiveWell's models; the evaluator view sets the rate to 0, so HLI's numbers reproduce.

Discount rate on future benefits
rows.explainer: The shared discount rate (Your values). HLI doesn't discount, so the evaluator view pins it at 0.

rows.label: Same rate, compounded continuously
rows.explainer: The yearly rate as a continuous rate, so benefits spread over years can be discounted smoothly rather than in yearly steps.

rows.label: Discount factor for the fading effect
rows.explainer: HLI's effect starts at the initial effect and fades in a straight line to zero over the duration (the triangle in the total-effect row). This is the present value of that triangle at the discount rate, as a share of its undiscounted area: 1 at a 0% rate, about 0.97 for a 2.2-year effect at 4%.
